item.title: India: Bridging Tradition and Tech for Innovation Excellence
item.description: India has emerged as a global leader in science, technology and innovation, rapidly excelling in space, defence, healthcare and start-ups while actively democratising scientific knowledge for all citizens.

item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU Pioneers AI for Research, Education and Industry
item.description: PolyU is advancing AI-powered research, literature analysis and human-robot collaboration, positioning Hong Kong as a global hub for innovation and human-centric development.

item.title: Vietnam: Robust AML Framework in the Digital Finance Era
item.description: Vietnam is strengthening its anti-money laundering framework to address growing financial risks from digital assets and new investment channels as it advances the development of an international financial centre.

item.title: Australia: Advancing Integrated Counter-Drone Capabilities
item.description: Australia’s Army is advancing its ICARUS programme, integrating detection, command and response systems to counter evolving drone threats, protect personnel, and enhance overall battlefield security and operational resilience.

item.title: Thailand: New Cybersecurity Curriculum Boosts AI Skills for Youth
item.description: Thailand’s MHESI, Chulalongkorn University and AIS have launched a free nationwide “Aunjai Cyber” AI Literacy course to equip students with practical, ethical and secure digital skills starting February 2026.

item.title: Malaysia: Smart, Sensor-Driven Water Quality Monitoring
item.description: AquaSURV, an unmanned surface vehicle from Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, enables safer real-time water monitoring, expanding environmental data access and improving pollution response.

item.title: Vietnam: Technology and Innovation Power Sustainable Growth
item.description: Vietnam in 2025 positions science, technology, innovation and digital transformation as central pillars to drive sustainable growth, economic development, social progress and a modern, knowledge-based economy.

item.title: Hong Kong: Simplifying Global Tech Talent Access for Growth
item.description: Hong Kong enhances its talent admission scheme to speed recruitment for research and development, widen eligible fields and support innovation park tenants.

item.title: India: CSIR Labs Propelling India’s Technological Leadership
item.description: Dr Jitendra Singh highlighted CSIR laboratories’ pivotal role in accelerating technology transfer, fostering industry collaboration and driving India’s innovation-led industrial, technological and societal growth nationwide.

item.title: Singapore: AI and Tech Sectors Power 2025 GDP Momentum
item.description: Singapore’s 2025 economic growth outperformed expectations, driven by AI-related electronics, ICT services, digital innovation and tech-enabled manufacturing, financial, enterprise and emerging sectors.
